business_problem: Traditional inspection, monitoring and protection of critical infrastructure required sending staff into the field, consuming significant time and money, slowing incident detection and increasing operational risk for assets such as power lines, pipelines and forested areas.
solution_summary: Telefónica has built a Drone as a Service operating model for critical infrastructure inspection that combines its drone service, Drone-in-a-Box technology, 5G network, edge computing, computer vision and artificial intelligence. At the ingest layer, drones stationed at the mission site capture high-definition, thermal and visual imagery from assets such as power lines, pipelines and forested areas while a remote pilot operates them from a control centre. The 5G network links the field location to the control centre and carries video and telemetry with licensed-spectrum connectivity and encryption. Rather than sending raw imagery to a central server, edge computing hosts the computer vision and AI workloads close to the network edge, where they detect anomalies, structural defects and intrusions in near real time. The system then filters and prioritises findings, sending conclusions and alerts to human operators for supervised decisions, regulatory compliance and faster response.

solution_components.name: Drone-in-a-Box technology
solution_components.role: Keeps the drone on site in standby mode so missions can launch within minutes without sending a pilot to the location.

solution_components.name: 5G network

solution_components.name: edge computing
solution_components.role: Runs image analysis close to the network edge so processing happens in real time with minimal latency instead of at a central server.

solution_components.name: computer vision
solution_components.role: Analyses thermal and visual images to identify anomalies, structural defects and security intrusions.

solution_components.name: artificial intelligence
solution_components.role: Filters, prioritises and converts detected events into conclusions, alerts and recommendations for operators.

data_flow: At the mission site, drones and on-board cameras capture thermal and visual imagery from critical assets. The feeds travel over Telefónica's 5G network to edge computing resources near the network edge, where computer vision and AI analyse images in real time instead of sending them to a central server. The platform returns prioritised conclusions and alerts to remote pilots and operators in control centres for validation and response.
